WITH own_session AS (
 SELECT '29aa1ab7-cae4-4975-908e-7123a467a2b5'::uuid AS id
), own_claims AS (
 SELECT n.id,n.session_id,n.round_id,n.report_id,n.request_key,n.state,n.claimed_at,n.expires_at,n.failure_code
 FROM combat_consumer_private.narrative_claims n JOIN own_session s ON s.id=n.session_id
), own_calls AS (
 SELECT q.id,q.producer,q.scope_id,q.source_id,q.call_no,q.state,q.reserved_usd,q.charged_usd,
  q.input_tokens,q.output_tokens,q.created_at,q.sent_at,q.settled_at
 FROM staff_ai_quota_private.calls q
 WHERE q.producer='combat_narratore_ai'
  AND (q.scope_id=(SELECT id FROM own_session) OR q.source_id IN(SELECT id FROM own_claims))
)
SELECT jsonb_build_object(
 'captured_at',clock_timestamp(),'session_id',(SELECT id FROM own_session),
 'summary',(SELECT jsonb_build_object(
  'quota_rows',count(*),
  'http_sent',count(*) FILTER(WHERE sent_at IS NOT NULL AND state<>'no_http'),
  'settled',count(*) FILTER(WHERE state='settled'),
  'pending',count(*) FILTER(WHERE state IN('reserved','sent')),
  'unknown_billable',count(*) FILTER(WHERE state='unknown_billable'),
  'over_cap',count(*) FILTER(WHERE state='over_cap'),
  'no_http',count(*) FILTER(WHERE state='no_http'),
  'input_tokens',coalesce(sum(input_tokens),0),
  'output_tokens',coalesce(sum(output_tokens),0),
  'charged_usd',coalesce(sum(charged_usd),0),
  'unsettled_reserved_usd',coalesce(sum(reserved_usd) FILTER(WHERE state IN('reserved','sent','unknown_billable')),0)
 ) FROM own_calls),
 'quota_calls',(SELECT coalesce(jsonb_agg(to_jsonb(q) ORDER BY q.created_at,q.id),'[]'::jsonb) FROM own_calls q),
 'narrative_claims',(SELECT coalesce(jsonb_agg(to_jsonb(n) ORDER BY n.claimed_at,n.id),'[]'::jsonb) FROM own_claims n),
 'scene_attempts',(SELECT coalesce(jsonb_agg(jsonb_build_object(
  'claim_id',a.claim_id,'request_key',a.request_key,'round_id',a.round_id,'state',a.state,
  'permit_at',a.permit_at,'result_at',a.result_at,'failure_code',a.failure_code,
  'redelivery_state',a.redelivery_state
 ) ORDER BY a.created_at,a.claim_id),'[]'::jsonb)
 FROM combat_consumer_private.scene_attempts_v2 a JOIN own_session s ON s.id=a.session_id)
) AS capture;

WITH own_scope AS(
 SELECT 'f4732666-764b-4eaa-9ccc-3a3ca989a920'::uuid session_id,
  '992432d3-5502-486c-885d-f09a237f02f7'::uuid round_id

)
SELECT jsonb_build_object(
 'captured_at',clock_timestamp(),'session_id',(SELECT session_id FROM own_scope),'round_id',(SELECT round_id FROM own_scope),
 'report',(SELECT jsonb_build_object('id',r.id,'narration_state',r.narration_state,'message_id',r.message_id,
  'values_written',r.mechanics->'values_written','order_version',r.mechanics->'order_version',
  'declarations',(SELECT jsonb_agg(jsonb_build_object(
   'id',dv.value->>'id','kind',dv.value->>'kind','actor',dv.value->'actor','order',dv.value->'order','state',dv.value->>'state',
   'parent',dv.value->'parent','target',dv.value->'target','chakra_cost',dv.value#>'{cost,chakra}',
   'copy_result',dv.value#>>'{outcome,multiplication_predefense,result}',
   'attack_consumed',dv.value#>'{outcome,multiplication_predefense,attack_consumed}',
   'defense_required',dv.value#>'{outcome,multiplication_predefense,defense_required}',
   'copy_intercepted',dv.value#>'{outcome,multiplication_effect,copy_intercepted}',

 ) FROM own_report r),

  'attack_target_id',f.attack_target_id,'defender_actor_id',f.defender_actor_id,'orientation_source',f.orientation_source,
  'level',f.level,'deduction',f.deduction,'rear',f.rear,'reason',f.reason,'created_at',f.created_at)
  ORDER BY f.created_at,f.id),'[]'::jsonb)
  FROM combat_facing_private.defense_receipts f JOIN own_scope s ON s.session_id=f.session_id AND s.round_id=f.round_id),
 'orientations_after',(SELECT coalesce(jsonb_agg(jsonb_build_object('actor_id',o.actor_id,'source_declaration_id',o.source_declaration_id,
  'opponent_actor_id',o.opponent_actor_id,'instance_id',o.instance_id,'map_version',o.map_version,
  'dx',o.dx,'dy',o.dy,'valid',o.valid,'reason',o.reason,'revision',o.revision,'updated_at',o.updated_at,
  'frame_schema',o.coordinate_frame->>'schema_version','frame_sha256',public.combat_v2_sha256(o.coordinate_frame))
  ORDER BY o.actor_id),'[]'::jsonb)
  FROM combat_facing_private.orientations o JOIN own_scope s ON s.session_id=o.session_id)
) capture;
